title: Intermittent Token Issuance Errors
customerImpact: A small percentage of new API key and OAuth token requests failed with 500 errors between 08:10 and 09:22 UTC. Existing sessions unaffected.
investigation: Error rate correlated with a Redis cluster node restart cycle.
rootCause: A Redis node was restarting after a memory fragmentation event; the token cache read path returned errors instead of falling back to PostgreSQL.
mitigation: Deployed read fallback to PostgreSQL for token cache misses.
resolution: Error rate returned to 0%. No tokens lost; failed requests retried successfully.

updates.author: Sarah Kim, SRE
